title: New Vehicle Replacement Bonus
content:
## New vehicle replacement bonus — Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

A holder who applies a replacement vehicle credit toward a new vehicle receives a bonus added to the credit. The replacement purchase is the holder's most recently signed group purchase deal in the Vehicle Purchase Agreements records: the deal whose vehicle price was charged last (of two charged the same day, the one recorded first), where that deal stands in contracted status. Its deal type and its contract date (the date the buyer's order was signed) are read from that deal. The paid line is the waiver's most recent paid GAP balance line, and the date it was paid is the date of that line.

| Replacement purchase | Signed, counted in calendar days after the date the paid line was paid (day 0) | Bonus added to the credit |
|---|---|---|
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase or New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 0 to 30 days (within 30 days) | 500.00 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase or New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | More than 30 days | 250.00 |
| Any other deal type, or a new-vehicle deal signed before the paid line was paid | — | None |

**Edges.** Signed on the payment day or on day 30: 500.00. Signed on day 31: 250.00. A Used Vehicle Retail Purchase, a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase or a Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase earns no new-vehicle bonus however soon it is signed.

**Hypothetical example.** A paid line dated Day 0 and a New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase signed on Day 12 give a bonus of 500.00; the same deal signed on Day 44 gives 250.00.
